request_ko: 재사용 가능한 무표기 보온병을 신뢰할 수 있고 기억에 남게 소개하는 광고 사진을 만들어줘.
concept: 재사용 가능한 무표기 보온병을 신뢰할 수 있고 기억에 남게 소개하는 광고 사진
expected_pixel_signals: the unlabeled reusable insulated bottle is immediately identifiable as the sole commercial subject
one visible functional interaction supports trust without readable claims
one restrained compositional or material relation makes the product memorable without obscuring it
forbidden_convergence: mystery or visual trick that hides product form or function
logo text slogan or unsupported performance claim
feature clutter or unrelated lifestyle props

request_ko: 성인 현장 조사원과 작은 비인간 동료가 망가진 장비를 함께 복구하는 귀엽고 관계 중심의 사진을 만들어줘.
concept: 성인 현장 조사원과 작은 비인간 동료가 망가진 장비를 함께 복구하는 귀엽고 관계 중심의 사진
expected_pixel_signals: clearly adult field surveyor and one original small nonhuman companion share the same damaged device
each participant performs a directed complementary repair action and visibly responds to the other
cuteness comes from earnest scale and reciprocal behavior rather than youth-coded human morphology
forbidden_convergence: human and creature merely posing or looking cute
recognizable mascot franchise or protected character design
childlike human proportions school cues or decorative costume-only moe

request_ko: 오래 살던 집을 떠나는 성인의 마지막 아침을 감동적이고 작가적으로 표현한 사진을 만들어줘.
concept: 오래 살던 집을 떠나는 성인의 마지막 아침을 감동적이고 작가적으로 표현한 사진
expected_pixel_signals: one clearly adult resident performs a concrete final-departure action in a lived-in home at morning
the emotional cause is visible through actor action target and irreversible consequence rather than a sadness label
a secondary causal trace changes the reading on reinspection while supporting the same departure meaning
forbidden_convergence: generic person staring through a rainy window
stacked nostalgia props or sentimental text
ambiguous youth-coded subject or unexplained surreal anomalies
